verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no way to cancel, unsubmit, or edit a payroll once it has been submitted and before the check date. Off-cycle payrolls "for corrections" are a separate payroll run used for adjustments, not cancellation or correction of a submitted payroll. That makes them an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can cancel or correct a submitted payroll before employees are paid
